source: Over many examples, tokens that participate in similar predictive contexts can be pushed toward representations that support similar downstream computations. But there is no requirement that Euclidean neighborhoods become human-interpretable unless the objective makes that geometry useful.
zh: 在许多示例中，参与类似预测上下文的令牌可以被推向支持类似下游计算的表示。但并不要求欧几里得邻域成为人类可解释的，除非目标使几何变得有用。
